reviews.title: Problems
reviews.text: Very useful for a beginner but has bad photo recognition and a selection of fish too small. It also seems overpriced for premium.

This really sounded like a great app, and I think it would have been but you have to pay weekly. And  not to mention they MAKE you rate the app if you want to look up fish or whatever, that was annoying.  The app is totally useless if you don’t want to pay a ridiculous amount of money a week FOR A FISH APP!

reviews.title: Bad for the subscription and it's not working
reviews.text: I purchased the pro version and it's not working. Deleted and reinstalled the app to see if that was it and it didn't work. 10 dollars wasted.

reviews.title: Doesn’t warn when stocking incompatible fish
Useless
reviews.text: Right nice app why pay money when you can get it free somewhere else. Its not like they dont remind you every second that you need premium for most things

reviews.title: Limited catalog
reviews.text:
Very limited fish catalog. Small selection of Synodontis, plecos, and cichlids. Unable to enter fish not in the catalog. Most of the fish entries do not have thumbnail photos. Most of the fish I have are not in it-
Poor identification of fish from photos-
